title: Dune Thyme Vacation Rental
meta_description: Dune Thyme is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionDune ThymePalms of Dune Allen – Unit #103West Co Hwy 30A, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459Home Highlights3 Bedrooms (see “Room Details” tab for configurations)3 Bathrooms1,686 Sq. Ft.Gulf-Front PropertyCompletely Renovated: all new furnishings, kitchen, appliances, flooring, and updated bathroomsKing Master Suite with Tempur-Pedic mattress and private bath featuring a walk-in showerKing Guest Master with Tempur-Pedic mattress and private bath with tub/shower comboBunk Room with two full-over-full bunks and access to a bathroom with tub/shower comboGated Parking for one vehicle only (no overflow parking)Seasonally Heated Communal PoolRing Camera on front doorProperty DescriptionWelcome to Dune Thyme, a beautifully renovated, gulf-front retreat located in the charming boutique community of Palms of Dune Allen. With fresh ownership came a complete transformation—enjoy brand-new flooring, an all-new kitchen with updated appliances, and stylish furnishings throughout.This thoughtfully designed condo features two king bedrooms, each with its own private bathroom, plus a spacious bunk room with two full-over-full bunks and an adjacent bathroom accessible from both the bedroom and the hallway.Step outside the unit to enjoy seasonal Gulf views, direct beach access, and a gated community pool just steps away. As a quaint 24-unit complex, Palms of Dune Allen offers a quiet, relaxed atmosphere perfect for families and couples alike.You’ll love the convenience of being close to the shops and restaurants of Gulf Place, as well as the nearby Santa Rosa Golf & Beach Club. Whether you’re soaking up the sun, watching a stunning sunset just outside the back door, or unwinding poolside, Dune Thyme provides the perfect backdrop for a peaceful beach getaway.Community AmenitiesPrivate, gated beach boardwalkGated community pool with lounge areaParkingDesignated parking for one vehicle in the gated lotNo overflow parking availableGuests with more than one vehicle are subject to fines and/or towing at their own expenseReservation & Booking PoliciesPlease note: The cancellation policy and terms in the 30A Cottages & Concierge Vacation Rental Agreement, emailed at booking confirmation, override any policies shown on third-party booking sites. Third-party service fees cannot be reimbursed.We do not offer a 100% refund for cancellations after booking is processedA 5% cancellation fee applies to all cancellations to cover processing costsAdditional PoliciesNO SMOKINGPets Not Allowed (Certified service animals only. Please notify us in advance with proper documentation so we may arrange appropriate housekeeping after departure.)Published rates do not include taxes and fees50% of total cost is due at the time of bookingRemaining balance due 60 days before arrivalIf arriving within 60 days, payment is due in full at time of bookingExcept for the 5% fee, the initial payment is refundable when cancellations occur more than 60 days before arrivalTravel Insurance available; must be purchased before final payment or when paying in fullCheck-In: 4:00 PM (CST) Check-Out: 10:00 AMMinimum Age Requirement: Primary tenant must be 25+ and present for the entire stay. Keys will not be issued to anyone under 25. (See rental contract for full details.)
